title: HStream
tagline: Introducing H-Stream, where teaching meets entrepreneurship. Create, customize, and sell courses directly from your own webpage. Design your site to reflect your brand, upload content effortlessly, and engage students with interactive learning experiences.
description:
Welcome to H-stream, a revolutionary platform that combines the flexibility of Udemy with the power to create and sell courses from your very own webpage. Whether you're an expert in photography, programming, cooking, or any other skill you're passionate about, H-stream empowers you to share your knowledge with the world and monetize your expertise like never before.

With H-stream, you have the freedom to design your own webpage, reflecting your unique style and brand identity. No more conforming to generic templates or being lost in a sea of competitors. Showcase your personality, expertise, and course offerings in a way that resonates with your audience, and watch your online presence flourish.

Creating and managing courses on H-stream is intuitive and hassle-free. Our user-friendly interface allows you to effortlessly upload course content, from videos and presentations to quizzes and assignments. Whether you're a seasoned instructor or just starting out, we provide the tools and support you need to create engaging and high-quality learning experiences.

But what truly sets H-stream apart is its seamless integration of e-commerce functionality. Say goodbye to third-party platforms and complex payment gateways. With H-stream, you can sell your courses directly from your webpage, keeping full control over pricing, promotions, and revenue streams. We handle the logistics so you can focus on what you do best – creating amazing content and connecting with your audience.

Join the H-stream community today and unlock the full potential of your expertise. Whether you're a teacher, trainer, or thought leader, there's never been a better time to share your knowledge and build your brand. Take the next step in your online teaching journey with H-stream.
how_its_made: H-Stream is crafted using Next.js and Huddle 01, two powerful technologies that combine to create a seamless and dynamic learning platform. Next.js provides the foundation, offering server-side rendering, static site generation, and a robust development environment that ensures high performance and scalability. I am using Huddle01 for video stream and recording for teachers to have great classes and they can also record it. These technologies empower users to create, customize, and sell courses effortlessly while delivering an engaging and immersive learning experience. With Hstream, education meets innovation, thanks to the craftsmanship of Next.js and Huddle 01.
